summary: Order placement 500s on order-service are caused by the v2.14.0 release (dep-5101, deployed 12:10Z) which added a new MarginCheckValidator to the validation chain and removed the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(). The new validator throws NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 ('marginProfile is null') for F&O (FNO) orders, returning HTTP 500. Errors began at 12:12:31Z, 2.4 minutes after rollout completed, and error_rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~18% where it remains (~257 more errors through 13:58Z). Only FNO orders are affected, matching the support tickets. All order-service resources (CPU ~40%, memory ~60%, db pool ~14, restarts 0, p99 ~150ms) are flat, and all downstream dependencies (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway, portfolio-service) are clean, ruling out resource exhaustion, capacity saturation and dependency failure. The deploy has not been rolled back. Recommended fix: roll back dep-5101 / hotfix the null-marginProfile handling.

ranked_hypotheses.title: New MarginCheckValidator in v2.14.0 dereferences null marginProfile for F&O accounts
ranked_hypotheses.statement: Deploy dep-5101 (order-service v2.14.0) introduced a new MarginCheckValidator in the validation chain replacing the legacy OrderRules.validateMargin(). The new code dereferences a margin profile that the legacy path had handled (or fetched) differently, throwing NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.java:88 and returning HTTP 500 for every F&O order whose marginProfile is null. Fault originates in the order-service code release.

causal_chain.claim: dep-5101 deploys new MarginCheckValidator and removes legacy margin validation
New validator dereferences null marginProfile for FNO orders
Unhandled NPE propagates to HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders
Error rate jumps from ~0.2% to ~18% and stays elevated

assumptions: The NPE stack frame MarginCheckValidator.java:88 is in code added by dep-5101 (validator is named in the deploy summary).
The legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() removed in the deploy previously guarded the null case.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Data issue: marginProfile data missing for some accounts, causing validator abort
ranked_hypotheses.statement: The failure is driven by missing/null margin-profile records for a subset of F&O accounts (e.g. a partial data load or newly onboarded accounts), which the pre-existing code tolerated but the new validator does not. Fault would originate in the data/margin store rather than the release itself.

causal_chain.claim: Some FNO accounts lack a marginProfile
New validator does not handle null and throws NPE

assumptions: The set of affected accounts is a specific cohort with no margin record.
No data-pipeline change occurred in the window (none observed).

ranked_hypotheses.title: Dependency failure (exchange/pricing/market-data) causing order rejections
ranked_hypotheses.statement: A downstream dependency (pricing-engine, exchange-gateway, or the external exchange API) degraded and caused order-submit failures, as in HIST-103.
ranked_hypotheses.rejection_reason: pricing-engine error_rate stays flat at ~0.22% with zero ERROR logs; exchange-gateway and portfolio-service have zero ERROR logs; order-service latency_p99 is unchanged (~150ms) and the error is a local Java NPE, not a timeout/504.

facts.statement: order-service dep-5101 (v2.14.0) deployed at 12:10Z added 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin().
The rollout of dep-5101 completed at 12:10:08Z.
First order-service error at 12:12:31Z is a NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) for orderType=FNO.
order-service error_rate rose from ~0.2% to 17.95% at 12:12Z and remains ~18% to 13:48Z.
All error logs for order-service are the two MarginCheckValidator NPE patterns, affecting only FNO orders.
The error is a Java NullPointerException 'marginProfile is null for account <id>'.
order-service cpu, memory, db pool, restarts and latency are flat across the incident window.
The only config change was notification-service email.batch_size (unrelated).
pricing-engine, exchange-gateway and portfolio-service show no errors — dependencies are healthy.
dep-5101 was not rolled back and errors continue through 13:58:50Z.
The earlier dep-5088 (portfolio-service 09:36Z) predates onset by ~2.5h and its service is error-free.

assumptions: MarginCheckValidator.java:88 belongs to the code added by dep-5101, per the deploy summary naming 'new MarginCheckValidator'.
The removed legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() previously handled the null-marginProfile case.
The marginProfile for affected accounts is genuinely absent/null in order-service's data at validation time (cause of the null is not fully determined — code defect vs data gap).

timeline.event: portfolio-service v4.2.1 (dep-5088, grpc bump) deployed — unrelated precursor.
order-service v2.14.0 (dep-5101) deployed: new MarginCheckValidator, legacy margin validation removed.
dep-5101 rollout complete, all pods ready.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back order-service to the pre-dep-5101 version (or hotfix MarginCheckValidator to null-guard / restore legacy OrderRules.validateMargin() fallback).
recommended_actions.rationale: The NPE is in the newly deployed validator and error_rate jumped immediately after rollout; rolling back removes the trigger.

recommended_actions.action: Add null-handling and unit tests for accounts without a marginProfile in the F&O validation path before re-releasing.
recommended_actions.rationale: The regression is a missing null guard on marginProfile; other null-field paths in the new validator likely share the defect.

recommended_actions.action: Gate order-validation changes behind canary/flag and add a synthetic FNO order smoke test in CI/deploy checks.
recommended_actions.rationale: A 2.4-minute detection gap and an un-rolled-back live deploy let ~18% error rate persist for >1.5h.

recommended_actions.action: Verify the marginProfile source for affected accounts (confirm whether it is genuinely null for some accounts) to ensure the hotfix matches reality.
recommended_actions.rationale: Distinguishes whether a null guard suffices or the margin data itself needs correction.

data_gaps: No direct source-code/diff for MarginCheckValidator.java was available, so the exact null-dereference line cannot be confirmed beyond the stack-trace frame.
It is not determined why marginProfile is null for the affected F&O accounts (absent record vs. not fetched) — no query into the margin/ledger data store was possible.
No margin-store/ledger-db telemetry was checked for null or missing profile records around 12:10Z.
The 11:30-13:00Z error log query was truncated (40 of 191) and the 12:55-13:59Z query truncated (10 of 257); all sampled patterns were identical, but not every line was inspected.
